warnings: THE CRUSH IS NEVER DEPICTED. No body, no fallen person, no CPR, no stretcher, no blood, no covered figure, in any frame, including the thumbnail. The alley appears in exactly three states: empty, ordinarily busy, after. The event is carried by sound, by the width of the walls and by the slope. This is the one failure the channel cannot recover from.

THE TOLL IS 159 AND NEVER 160. 159 is the official figure recorded by the Ministry of the Interior and Safety and carried by named reporting through March 2026. The figure 160 appears in an English summary of a Korean forensic study reported 22 July 2026 and is not the official toll. It may not appear in narration, caption, title, thumbnail or description.

NO FINAL LEGAL OUTCOME IS ASSERTED FOR ANYONE, AND NONE EXISTS. Only first-instance judgments were delivered. BOTH APPEALS WERE SUSPENDED -- Seoul High Court Criminal Division 13 on 14 July 2025 for the police defendants, Criminal Division 9-1 on 28 August 2025 for the district office chief -- so that the special investigation commission could re-establish the facts. Every named person carries their status, its date and its court inside the same sentence that names them.

FACES ARE PERMITTED AND WANTED (owner decision 2026-08-21). The [NEG] blocks must NOT contain human face, facial features, eye contact or headshot. They contain identifiable person, recognisable person and likeness of a real individual, which satisfies the NEG gate without erasing the crowd. The crowd is the subject of this film.

KOREA IS NOT INTERCHANGEABLE WITH JAPAN OR CHINA. Kana, Chinese shopfronts, red lanterns and Tokyo neon are the same class of error as an EU number plate in a Texas film. Signage in frame is hangul or unreadable. Korean courts do not use a gavel.

NO COUNTERFACTUAL. Nothing 'would have' prevented it. No verified finding establishes that closing the street, one-way flow, more officers or a safety plan would have changed the outcome, and the script states that refusal out loud three times.

QUARANTINE 16 IS THE MOST FRAGILE RULE IN THE EPISODE. Lee Im-jae's March 2026 testimony that the disaster was less likely without the presidential office move is a counterfactual spoken by a man convicted at first instance with a suspended appeal. It is reported, attributed, dated and NEVER adopted, and the scene plan carries the same rule as a cutting instruction: under that testimony the picture stays on an empty hearing room, with no cut to the map.
